name: Lightmatter Passage L20 Product Page and Technical Specifications
notes: Official product page and technical specifications for Lightmatter Passage L20 scalable BiDi optical interconnect for NPO (Near-Packaged Optics) and OBO (On-Board Optics). Details 6.4 Tbps per direction ('Each direction'), 212.5 Gbps PAM4 SerDes line rate, 32 data fibers with Corning CPO Flexconnect, and 1827-ball BGA form factor.
